name: Spain
visa_name: Spain Digital Nomad Visa (Ley de Startups)
min_monthly_income_local: €2,849/mo (200% of minimum wage, annualised; consulate monthly figure €2,442; resets each January)
tax_notes: Special Beckham Law regime applies: flat 24% tax rate up to €600,000 for up to 5 years.
key_requirements: Non-EEA/EU citizens
Proof of remote work for at least 3 months for companies outside Spain
Clean criminal background check apostilled
Private health insurance valid in Spain
Degree or 3+ years relevant work experience

name: Portugal
min_monthly_income_local: €3,680/mo (4x the 2026 minimum wage; resets each January)
tax_notes: Replaced NHR with IFICI program; progressive tax rates otherwise unless qualifying for specific talent schemes.
key_requirements: Remote contract or freelance contracts outside Portugal
Bank balance showing at least 12 months minimum income (~€44,160+)
NIF tax number and Portuguese bank account
1-year lease agreement or accommodation proof
Travel / Private health insurance

name: Thailand
min_monthly_income_local: 500,000 THB (~$14,000 USD bank savings)
tax_notes: Foreign-sourced income remitted in the same tax year is subject to Thai personal tax; funds remitted in later years or kept offshore generally tax-exempt.
key_requirements: Proof of 500,000 THB in bank account
Employment contract or freelance portfolio as a remote worker
Or enrollment in Muay Thai / Thai cooking / medical treatment
Valid passport with at least 6 months validity

name: Japan
min_monthly_income_local: ¥10,000,000 JPY annual income
tax_notes: Exempt from local Japanese income taxes under bilateral tax treaties for stays under 6 months.
key_requirements: Citizen of 49 designated visa-waiver countries (US, UK, EU, etc.)
Annual income of 10M JPY (~$68k USD) or higher
Private medical insurance covering up to 10M JPY
Spouse and children can accompany

name: Greece
min_monthly_income_local: €3,500 net per month (+20% for spouse)
tax_notes: 50% income tax deduction for up to 7 years if transferring tax residence to Greece.
key_requirements: Proof of €3,500/month stable remote earnings
Clean criminal record
Medical certificate & international health insurance
Rental lease in Greece
First applications must now be made at a Greek consulate for a Type D visa (Law 5275/2026, in force 6 Feb 2026); applying directly in-country is no longer possible.
A further €1,000 fee applies for the 2-year residence permit after entry, on top of the €75 national visa fee.

name: Croatia
min_monthly_income_local: €3,622.50 per month (2.5x the 2025 average net salary of €1,449; recalculated each spring)
tax_notes: 100% exempt from Croatian income tax on remote work income.
key_requirements: Third-country national (non-EU/EEA)
Proof of funds: €43,470 for a 12-month stay or €65,205 for 18 months, or monthly income proof
Permit may be extended once by 6 months; after the maximum stay, you must spend 6 months outside Croatia before reapplying
Full health insurance & local address registration (OIB)

name: Mexico
min_monthly_income_local: ~$4,050–$4,650/mo (680 days of UMA; exact figure varies by consulate), or ~$68,000–$78,000 in savings (11,460 days of UMA)
tax_notes: Income earned entirely outside Mexico from non-Mexican employers is generally not taxed unless Mexican tax residency is triggered.
key_requirements: Proof of financial solvency (last 6-12 months bank statements)
In-person interview at Mexican consulate outside Mexico
Exchange visa for Canje card at INM within 30 days of arrival (INM card fee about MXN 3,916, ~$214)

name: Costa Rica
visa_name: Costa Rica Estancia Visa for Remote Workers (Law 10008)
min_monthly_income_local: $3,000 USD/month (+ $1,000 for family)
tax_notes: Complete exemption from Costa Rican income tax, import tax on equipment, and duty on vehicles.
key_requirements: Proof of $3,000 USD monthly income over the past 12 months
Medical insurance covering entire stay ($50k coverage min)
Application submitted via Tramite Ya portal

name: United Arab Emirates (Dubai)
visa_name: Dubai Remote Work Visa (Virtual Working Programme)
min_monthly_income_local: $3,500 USD per month
tax_notes: 0% personal income tax, 0% capital gains tax.
key_requirements: Proof of employment with 1-year contract validity, or business ownership (owners need $5,000/month income)
Last month salary slip and 6 months of bank statements (GDRFA requirement since 27 Jan 2026)
Health insurance with UAE coverage
Government fees were cut in April 2026 (roughly AED 1,500-1,700 before medical exam, Emirates ID and insurance); check GDRFA for the current itemised total

name: Georgia
min_monthly_income_local: $2,000 USD/month or $24,000 savings (for special regimes)
tax_notes: Individual Entrepreneur Small Business Status offers 1% flat turnover tax up to ~180k USD; eligibility for foreign nationals may require a work permit - check current Revenue Service rules.
key_requirements: 365-day visa-free entry for US, EU, and many other passports - no application and no income requirement on this route

Remotely from Georgia permit: 12-month residence confirmation for remote workers earning $2,000+/month; the programme itself charges no application fee (an optional residence card for stays of 6+ months costs about GEL 210)
Health insurance recommended
A simple border run resets the 365-day visa-free counter

name: Malta
min_monthly_income_local: €42,000 annual gross income (€3,500/mo base; applies to applications from 1 Apr 2024 — earlier applications €32,400/year)
tax_notes: Authorised nomad work income is exempt from income tax for the first 12 months (exemption must be applied for); after that a flat 10% rate applies, whether or not the income is remitted to Malta.
key_requirements: Non-EU/EEA/Swiss national
Employment contract outside Malta or remote freelance business
Proof of €42,000 annual gross income
Valid rental lease agreement or property purchase in Malta
Health insurance covering the EU and the UK, meeting the Residency Malta minimum cover table (2026 guides cite a €100,000 annual limit)
A further €27.50 per person is payable in person (card only) for the residence card when you attend Residency Malta for biometrics.

name: Cyprus
min_monthly_income_local: €3,500/mo net (after tax abroad)
tax_notes: Spending over 183 days in a tax year while not being tax resident anywhere else makes you a Cyprus tax resident, taxed on worldwide income at progressive rates (0% up to the exempt threshold, rising to 35%). The non-dom 0% covers only Special Defence Contribution on dividends and passive interest (for 17 years) — it does not exempt employment or self-employment income.
key_requirements: Non-EU/EEA national working for overseas clients
Proof of €3,500 net monthly income (+20% for spouse, +15% per child)
Clean criminal record and apostilled police certificate
Adequate private medical insurance
Local residential lease contract in Cyprus
Government fee is €70 for the permit + €70 for first registration (€140 total)

name: Italy
visa_name: Italy Digital Nomad Visa (Visto Nomadi Digitali)
min_monthly_income_local: €24,789.93 annual gross income by law (3x the €8,263.31 healthcare cost-participation exemption threshold; individual consulates apply €24,789–€28,000)
tax_notes: The visa itself has no special tax rate: tax residents pay progressive IRPEF on worldwide income. The Regime Forfettario (5% substitute tax for the first 5 years, then 15%, turnover cap €85,000) is open only to self-employed Partita IVA holders, is charged on turnover multiplied by a profitability coefficient, and INPS social contributions (roughly 26%) come on top; employees cannot use it.
key_requirements: Highly qualified professional (degree or accredited license)
At least 6 months proven remote work experience
Tax compliance proof in home country
Comprehensive health insurance covering €30,000+ (minimum required by some consulates; the decree itself sets no amount — check your consulate)
Residential contract / lease in Italy

name: Estonia
min_monthly_income_local: €4,500/mo gross income in last 6 months
tax_notes: Tax residency triggered after 183 days. 22% flat personal tax rate (2026); e-Residency corporate income 0% on reinvested profits.
key_requirements: Employed by a non-Estonian employer or running location-independent business
Income threshold verified via last 6 months bank statements
Travel medical insurance covering at least €30,000 for entire stay
Written explanation of remote work nature
D visa runs up to 12 months and cannot be extended; a second D visa can bring the total to at most 548 days within 730 days

name: Hungary
min_monthly_income_local: €3,000/mo net income for past 6 months
tax_notes: 15% flat personal income tax for residents on worldwide income. The White Card carries no tax exemption: residence is determined first by permanent home and centre of vital interests, with the 183-day test only as a fallback, so treaty outcomes vary by individual.
key_requirements: Third-country non-EEA citizen
Employed by an employer outside Hungary or owns foreign company shares
Cannot pursue gainful employment for Hungarian entities
Comprehensive health insurance and proof of accommodation in Hungary (lease, property or booking)
Consulate fee €110; online applications HUF 26,000, in-person applications in Hungary HUF 39,000

name: Czech Republic
min_monthly_income_local: CZK 156,500 in bank balance proof (50x the CZK 3,130 subsistence minimum)
tax_notes: 15% personal income tax on a tax base up to about CZK 1,676,052, 23% above that. The optional Pausalni Dan lump-sum scheme (one monthly payment covering tax, social and health contributions) cost CZK 8,716/month for the first band in 2025.
key_requirements: Zivnostensky List (Czech Trade License) registration
Proof of sufficient funds in personal bank account
Proof of accommodation covering the full period of stay requested (lease, or owner's notarised confirmation of accommodation)
Comprehensive foreign health insurance (PVZP or equivalent)
Apostilled clean police clearance
Trade licence notification fee CZK 1,000 (≈$48) is charged separately by the Trade Licensing Office.

name: Latvia
min_monthly_income_local: 2.5x Latvian average salary (€4,538/mo; 2.5x the 2025 average gross wage of €1,815, per PMLP)
tax_notes: Remote-work visa holders may elect a 15% flat rate on OECD-employer or self-employment income, but only for 365 days from becoming a Latvian tax resident, only after registering with the State Revenue Service (VID), and only by giving up allowances and deductions; the general 25.5%/33% rates apply afterwards.
key_requirements: Third-country national employed by an OECD-registered employer or self-employed registered in an OECD country (applicant nationality is irrelevant)
Contract with employer registered in OECD country for at least 6 months
Proof of 2.5x Latvian average gross wage
Valid health insurance policy with a liability limit of at least €42,600
Note: the PMLP visa page still shows the previous €4,213 figure — it has not yet been updated to the €4,538 anchor in force since 1 Apr 2026

name: Romania
min_monthly_income_local: RON 27,576/mo (3x the RON 9,192 gross reference under the social insurance budget law; an INS-based figure runs higher, ~€5,525)
tax_notes: 0% tax on foreign-earned income — and no local social security contributions — while you stay no more than 183 days in any rolling 12-month period; beyond that, Romania's 10% flat income tax applies.
key_requirements: Employed by a foreign company, or owning a foreign company registered and operating for at least 3 years (the 3-year rule concerns the company, not employees)
Proof of income 3x national gross average for past 6 months
Clean criminal record and proof of accommodation
Medical insurance valid in Romania covering €30,000+

name: Albania
min_monthly_income_local: 50,000 ALL/mo (national minimum wage since 1 Jan 2026 — Council of Ministers Decision No. 776, 19 Dec 2025; 2026 guides use this as the benchmark) or 300,000 ALL bank deposit. The Interior Ministry procedure page still lists 32,000 ALL — the 2022 minimum-wage level — and appears not to have been updated; confirm on e-Albania before applying
tax_notes: 0% if self-employed with gross income up to ALL 14,000,000 per year through 31 Dec 2029 (Law 29/2023); employment income is taxed at 13% up to ALL 2,040,000/yr and 23% above (PwC).
key_requirements: Valid foreign work or service contract
Bank statements showing steady income at the required level (50,000 ALL/mo) or a 300,000 ALL deposit
Local residential rental lease in Albania
Valid travel medical insurance

name: Montenegro
min_monthly_income_local: €1,800–€2,400/mo (3x the minimum wage: €600 or €800 depending on qualification level)
tax_notes: Qualifying income from a foreign employer or company not registered in Montenegro is exempt from personal income tax (Art. 32d) and from social contributions (Art. 18d). Without the exemption, wages are taxed progressively (0% up to €700/mo, 9% to €1,000, 15% above) plus a municipal surtax.
key_requirements: Contract with foreign enterprise or proof of freelance service clients
Proof of income of at least €1,800–€2,400/mo over the previous year
Rental contract in Montenegro
Clean criminal record and international health insurance

name: Germany
min_monthly_income_local: No official fixed threshold — prove via a revenue forecast and client contracts/letters of intent that your income covers your living costs
tax_notes: Progressive income tax (2026): no tax up to the €12,348 basic allowance, then marginal rates from 14% rising to 42% (from €69,879) and 45% above €277,826.
key_requirements: Qualified liberal profession (coder, designer, journalist, consultant)
At least two letters of intent from prospective German or international clients, or fee-based client contracts
Proof of professional qualification / portfolio
German-compliant statutory or expat health insurance
Registered residential address (Anmeldung)
Applicants aged 45+ must show a pension entitlement of at least €1,612.53/month at age 67 (for at least 12 years) or assets of at least €232,204 (rule in force since 1 July 2025)

Plus the residence permit fee after arrival: €100 for the electronic permit (eAT) or €56 for a sticker permit, plus a small processing fee (about €13 in Berlin). Visa-exempt nationals who apply in-country pay only the permit fee.

name: Colombia
visa_name: Colombia Digital Nomad Visa (Visa V Nómadas Digitales)
min_monthly_income_local: 3x minimum legal monthly wages (COP 5,252,715/mo in 2026, ~$1,600 USD)
tax_notes: No tax liability on foreign-earned income if staying under 183 days within any 365-day rolling period.
key_requirements: Valid contract with foreign enterprise or entrepreneurial activities
Bank statements showing 3 months minimum wage equivalent
Health insurance with international coverage for entire stay
Valid passport with at least 2 blank pages

name: Brazil
min_monthly_income_local: $1,500/mo income or $18,000 lump sum bank balance
tax_notes: 0% tax on foreign income if staying under 183 days. Progressive rates (up to 27.5%) apply if staying longer.
key_requirements: Proof of remote employment outside Brazil
Monthly income of $1,500+ or $18,000 bank balance
Clean criminal record check from home country
Valid health insurance policy covering Brazilian territory

name: Argentina
min_monthly_income_local: No statutory minimum income — proof of genuine remote work (contract/invoices); income proof required only at renewal
tax_notes: Foreign remote income is exempt from Argentine taxes during the temporary nomad stay.
key_requirements: Contract with foreign employer or freelance invoicing history
Proof of professional qualification and curriculum vitae
Valid travel medical insurance covering Argentina
Valid passport from visa-exempt nation

name: Uruguay
min_monthly_income_local: No minimum income — signed sworn declaration of remote work and self-sufficiency
tax_notes: Territorial tax system: foreign-sourced active income earned outside Uruguay is 100% tax-free. Note that staying more than 183 days can trigger Uruguayan tax residency.
key_requirements: Complete online application after entering Uruguay on tourist visa
Signed affidavit confirming remote work outside Uruguay
Clean criminal record and vaccination certificate
Valid passport and international medical insurance

name: Ecuador
visa_name: Ecuador Digital Nomad Visa (Visa Rentista Nómada)
min_monthly_income_local: 3x basic unified salaries ($1,446/mo in 2026; SBU $482)
tax_notes: Income earned exclusively from foreign sources is not subject to Ecuadorian personal income tax.
key_requirements: Official remote employment contract or corporate ownership
Bank statements showing 3x basic salary for past 3 months
Police record certificate apostilled or legalized
Health insurance with coverage in Ecuador

name: Panama
visa_name: Panama Short Stay Remote Worker Visa
min_monthly_income_local: $3,000/mo ($36,000/yr) from foreign sources
tax_notes: Strict territorial tax system: income generated outside Panama is completely free from local taxation.
key_requirements: Letter from foreign employer or self-employed company documents
Bank statements showing $3,000/mo minimum foreign income
Medical insurance policy covering Panama
Sworn declaration of non-acceptance of employment in Panama

name: Belize
visa_name: Belize Work Where You Vacation Program
min_monthly_income_local: $75,000 annual income ($100k for couples)
tax_notes: Exempt from personal income taxes and business taxes on remote foreign earnings while non-resident; staying more than 183 days may make foreign income taxable.
key_requirements: Proof of foreign employment or business ownership
Proof of $75,000 USD annual income
Clean police record and international health insurance ($50k coverage)
Valid travel passport
The official online application link is currently dead — apply by email to the Immigration Department (visas@immigration.gov.bz)
Fee is BZ$500 per adult (about $250), paid at the airport on arrival after approval; children BZ$200

name: Barbados
min_monthly_income_local: $50,000 annual gross income
tax_notes: Exempt from local personal income tax under the Welcome Stamp legislation.
key_requirements: Remote work contract outside Barbados
Attestation of earning at least $50,000/year
Valid passport and passport-sized photo
Full health insurance coverage for the duration of stay
Programme currently authorised only until 31 Dec 2026 — confirm it has been renewed before applying

name: Bahamas
min_monthly_income_local: No fixed minimum — proof of employment or self-employment outside the Bahamas
tax_notes: Bahamas imposes 0% personal income tax, 0% corporate tax, and 0% capital gains tax.
key_requirements: Letter of employment from foreign employer or remote business proof
Proof of sufficient financial means to maintain stay
Valid medical insurance policy covering the Bahamas
Clean criminal record check

name: Bermuda
min_monthly_income_local: Substantial means and/or a continuous source of annual income — no fixed threshold
tax_notes: 0% income tax in Bermuda; certificate holders pay zero payroll taxes.
key_requirements: Remote worker or university student studying remotely
Proof of employment or company ownership outside Bermuda
Continuous source of annual income
Mandatory health insurance coverage

name: Dominica
min_monthly_income_local: $50,000 annual income
tax_notes: No personal income tax liability on foreign-sourced earnings under the WIN program.
key_requirements: Proof of foreign employment or remote enterprise
Anticipated annual income of $50,000+
Police record check and medical health certificate
Valid health insurance policy covering Dominica

name: Curaçao
min_monthly_income_local: No fixed minimum — proof of means via employer's declaration, employment contract or client contracts
tax_notes: Remote workers are not considered tax residents and pay 0% income tax on foreign income.
key_requirements: Contract with foreign enterprise or freelance clientele
Proof of adequate financial means
International travel and medical insurance
Confirmed return flight ticket and accommodation booking

name: Indonesia
min_monthly_income_local: $60,000 annual income ($5,000/mo)
tax_notes: There is no official tax exemption for E33G holders: staying more than 183 days makes you an Indonesian tax resident, taxable on worldwide income.
key_requirements: Official employment contract with overseas company outside Indonesia
Bank balance showing at least $2,000 USD
Proof of $60,000 annual salary ($5,000/mo)
Passport with at least 6 months validity

name: Malaysia
min_monthly_income_local: Over $24,000 annual income for tech roles (~$2,000/mo); over $60,000/year for non-tech roles
tax_notes: Foreign-sourced remote income earned while living in Malaysia is exempt from Malaysian personal income tax.
key_requirements: Digital freelancer or remote worker in IT/digital tech domains
Minimum annual income of $24,000 USD (tech roles) or $60,000 USD (non-tech roles)
Active client or employment contracts outside Malaysia
Valid passport and personal health insurance
Pass is issued for 3–12 months depending on contract length; renewable once, up to 24 months in total

name: Taiwan
visa_name: Taiwan Digital Nomad Visitor Visa (annotation code DN)
min_monthly_income_local: US$40,000/yr if 30+ / US$20,000/yr if 20–29, in either of the last 2 years; or hold another country's nomad visa (no income proof needed). Plus 6-month average savings ≥ US$10,000.
tax_notes: As a visitor visa, the DNV carries no special tax rate. Taiwan tax residency follows the 183-day rule — stays of 183 days or more in a calendar year generally make you a Taiwan tax resident, taxed on Taiwan-sourced income (and, for residents, on a wider basis). No Gold Card 50% salary deduction applies to this visa. Dependants: legally possible since 1 Jan 2026; procedure not yet published — confirm with a Taiwan mission before applying. Looking for a longer, work-authorised route? Taiwan's Employment Gold Card is a separate programme (goldcard.nat.gov.tw).
key_requirements: National of a visa-exempt country; remote work for employers/clients outside Taiwan only
Income: US$40,000/yr (age 30+) or US$20,000/yr (age 20–29) in either of the last two years — or hold a digital nomad visa issued by another country (no income proof needed)
Average bank balance ≥ US$10,000 over the last 6 months
International health insurance covering the full stay; resume/portfolio, work contract(s), and a description of intended activities

name: South Korea
min_monthly_income_local: 1x–2x Korean GNI per capita by age and region (2025 GNI: KRW 52,416,000/yr; standard tier 2x = KRW 104,832,000/yr, ~$6,400/mo)
tax_notes: Workation visa holders performing tasks for foreign employers pay 0% Korean tax on remote foreign income.
key_requirements: Employed by overseas company for at least 1 year in same industry
Annual income of 1x–2x the Bank of Korea GNI per capita, depending on age and region (2025 GNI: KRW 52,416,000)
Clean criminal record check apostilled
Private medical insurance with coverage of at least 100,000,000 KRW

name: Philippines
min_monthly_income_local: No income figure set by EO 86; in practice about USD 24,000/year (~$2,000/mo) of foreign-sourced income
tax_notes: Non-resident aliens pay 0% tax on income sourced outside the Philippines.
key_requirements: Valid foreign employment or freelance contracts
Proof of sufficient remote earnings to maintain stay
Travel and medical insurance covering Philippine territory
Clean police certificate and valid passport
Reciprocity applies: your country must offer a similar visa to Filipino citizens and host a Philippine foreign post; the official list of eligible countries has not yet been published

Status (Nov 2026): created by Executive Order 86 in April 2025, but the DFA has not yet published implementing guidelines, a fee or an application channel — applications are not yet open. Figures shown are unofficial estimates.

name: Sri Lanka
min_monthly_income_local: $2,000/mo foreign income remitted to Sri Lanka (+ $500/mo per dependent beyond two)
tax_notes: Since 1 April 2025 there is no 0% exemption: tax residents (183+ days in a year of assessment) pay up to 15% on foreign-currency income remitted through a bank (15% is a cap, not a flat rate); foreign income not remitted is taxed at progressive rates up to 36%.
key_requirements: Proof of $2,000/mo income channelled through commercial banking accounts
Employment or freelance contracts with entities outside Sri Lanka
Clean police check and return flight ticket
Valid international travel health insurance

name: Türkiye
tax_notes: Foreign remote work earnings generally free from local personal income taxes if staying under 183 days.
key_requirements: Citizen of designated eligible countries (age 21-55)
University degree diploma
Contract with company located outside Türkiye
Proof of $3,000 monthly income and valid medical insurance

name: Mauritius
min_monthly_income_local: $1,500/mo (+ $500 for each dependent under 24)
tax_notes: Foreign income is taxed only once you are tax resident (183+ days) and only to the extent it is remitted to Mauritius; remitted income is taxed at progressive rates of 0%/10%/20% (since 1 July 2025). Money kept or spent from foreign accounts without remittance is not taxed.
key_requirements: Produce proof of long-stay travel plans and accommodation
Proof of funds ($1,500/mo remote income)
Do not enter Mauritius labor market
Full travel and health insurance policy

name: Cape Verde
min_monthly_income_local: €1,500/mo (€2,700 for families) in bank statements
tax_notes: 0% income tax on remote earnings under the official Cabo Verde Nomad statute.
key_requirements: Citizen from Europe, North America, PALOP, or ECOWAS
Bank balance showing steady €1,500/mo income for past 6 months
Health insurance with repatriation coverage
Booking of local accommodation

name: South Africa
min_monthly_income_local: R650,976 annual gross income
tax_notes: Exempt from registering with SARS for South African personal taxes if staying under 6 months within 12 months.
key_requirements: Employed by foreign entity with contract
Proof of annual gross income of at least R650,976
Police clearance and medical radiology report
Comprehensive international medical insurance

name: Namibia
min_monthly_income_local: $2,000/mo for applicant (+ $1,000 for spouse, + $500 per accompanying child)
tax_notes: No local income taxes incurred on remote earnings during the 6-month stay.
key_requirements: Proof of remote employment or business ownership outside Namibia
6 months bank statements demonstrating $2,000/mo income
Valid medical insurance for stay duration
Clean police certificate and medical report

name: Seychelles
min_monthly_income_local: No fixed minimum — proof of income or funds to cover the stay
tax_notes: 0% tax on foreign earnings under the Workcation Visitors Work Permit.
key_requirements: Valid foreign remote employment letter or commercial ownership
Proof of adequate funds for living on islands
Valid travel medical insurance covering Covid/emergency care
Confirmed accommodation booking in certified establishment
